title: Lacson: Senators may need more time to decide on impeachment threshold

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator-judges may need more time before finally deciding on whether the voting threshold for conviction in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte should be reduced, Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson said Saturday. Lacson made the pronouncements amid the conclusion of the 26th day of Duterte’s trial on Wednesday where four retired Supreme Court justices weighed in on the constitutional questions surrounding the voting threshold.
